headline: NSE seeks clarification from Lokesh Machines over sharp stock price movement
hook: Unusual price movement draws exchange scrutiny
summary: The National Stock Exchange has sought a clarification from Lokesh Machines Limited following a significant movement in its share price. The exchange intervened to ensure investors have access to the latest relevant information and to safeguard market integrity. The company has since submitted its official response to the exchange inquiry. Indian retail investors holding the stock should review upcoming disclosures for any price-sensitive announcements.
whats_next: Lokesh Machines disclosure of exchange clarification
why_it_matters: Exchange queries on price volatility signal potential pending disclosures.

headline: P.Kodanda Rami Reddy resigns as Lokesh Machines Company Secretary
summary: Lokesh Machines Limited has announced the resignation of Mr P.Kodanda Rami Reddy from his role as Company Secretary and Compliance Officer, effective October 10, 2026.
